"""Modify slide1 and slide2 of the pptx:
- Move picture in slide 2 to top of slide (y=0)
- Underline all textbox text on slide 1 and slide 2
"""
import re
import shutil
import os
import zipfile

EXTRACT_DIR = "/tmp/pptx_extract"
SRC = "/home/user/Desktop/43_1.pptx"
OUT = "/home/user/Desktop/43_1.pptx"

def add_underline_to_rpr(xml_text):
    """Add u="sng" attribute to all <a:rPr ...> and <a:endParaRPr ...> tags
    that don't already have a u= attribute."""
    def fix(match):
        full = match.group(0)
        tag = match.group(1)  # rPr or endParaRPr
        attrs = match.group(2)
        if re.search(r'\bu\s*=', attrs):
            return full  # already has u attribute
        # Insert u="sng" right after the tag name
        return f'<a:{tag} u="sng"{attrs}>'
    pattern = re.compile(r'<a:(rPr|endParaRPr)((?:\s[^>]*)?)>')
    return pattern.sub(fix, xml_text)

# ---- slide1.xml: only underline ----
slide1_path = os.path.join(EXTRACT_DIR, "ppt/slides/slide1.xml")
with open(slide1_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    s1 = f.read()
s1_new = add_underline_to_rpr(s1)
with open(slide1_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(s1_new)
print("Slide 1 underlines applied. rPr matches:", len(re.findall(r'<a:rPr', s1_new)))

with open(slide2_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    s2 = f.read()

# Move picture to top: find the <p:pic> ... </p:pic> block and replace its <a:off ... y=...>
# Picture has off x="7383240" y="2499480" — we change y to 0 (slide top).
pic_match = re.search(r'(<p:pic\b.*?</p:pic>)', s2, re.DOTALL)
if not pic_match:
    raise SystemExit("No <p:pic> found in slide 2")

pic_xml = pic_match.group(1)
# Replace y attribute in the <a:off> within the picture's <p:spPr><a:xfrm>
new_pic_xml = re.sub(
    r'(<a:off\s+x="[^"]*"\s+y=")[^"]*(")',
    r'\g<1>0\g<2>',
    pic_xml,
    count=1,
)
s2_pic_moved = s2.replace(pic_xml, new_pic_xml)

s2_new = add_underline_to_rpr(s2_pic_moved)
with open(slide2_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(s2_new)
print("Slide 2 picture moved & underlines applied.")

# ---- Repack pptx ----
# Build a fresh zip containing all extracted files
TMP_OUT = "/tmp/43_1_new.pptx"
if os.path.exists(TMP_OUT):
    os.remove(TMP_OUT)
with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP_OUT, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(EXTRACT_DIR):
        for fn in files:
            full = os.path.join(root, fn)
            arc = os.path.relpath(full, EXTRACT_DIR)
            zf.write(full, arc)

shutil.copy(TMP_OUT, OUT)
print("Wrote", OUT)
